headline: NYY @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is NYY 4.07 at BOS 3.48, with a projected total of 7.55. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward BOS: NYY moved -0.61 runs while BOS moved -0.17, changing the projected margin by -0.44 runs. The projected total fell -0.78, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +6.9%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Cam Schlittler has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Paul Goldschmidt, Ceddanne Rafaela, Anthony Volpe, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Jarren Duran, Max Schuemann because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
